turn.question: what should I test first on my landing page?
turn.answer:
Start with the headline. It is the one line every visitor reads, so a change there shows up in sign-ups fastest.

- **Test one thing at a time.** Keep the picture and the button the same.
- **Run it for at least a week**, so weekdays and the weekend both count.
- **Score it on sign-ups**, not on clicks.

When you have two headlines you like, ask me to set up the test.
